messages:
sara (CS): Hi team — ACME's security lead just sent a vendor questionnaire focused on encryption, key management, data residency, and retention. They want answers by EOD tomorrow. Can we triage?

jordan (AE): Ack. Send the specific questions and I'll prep customer context and timelines.

sara (CS): Pasted main Qs below: 1) Do we support customer-managed keys / BYOK? 2) Is BYOK available for Hosted/Dedicated/Private? 3) What are default retention windows for request logs & embeddings? 4) Where does SOC2 cover our hosting/control plane? They also want a legal contact for the DPA.

nate (Legal): I can draft the legal-safe language. Short answers up front: Dedicated + Private = BYOK support; Hosted = provider-managed by default (no BYOK unless contracted). Need to confirm exact verbiage for the questionnaire.

olivia (CSE): Operational note: For Dedicated we support customer-managed keys via cloud KMS integrations; for Private (VPC or on-prem) we can integrate with customer HSMs. Hosted API uses platform-managed keys unless a contract includes a managed BYOK offering.

olivia (CSE): ```yaml
encryption:
  mode: customer_managed
  providers: ["aws-kms", "gcp-kms", "azure-keyvault", "onprem-hsm"]
  note: "Hosted API uses provider-managed encryption by default; BYOK available on Dedicated/Private under agreement."
```

sara (CS): Nice. Nate — can you draft a one-paragraph answer we can paste into the vendor form? Also need a short line about retention (they mention 90 days as a checkbox option).

nate (Legal): Draft below — please sanity-check from ops before I finalize: "Redwood Inference supports customer-managed encryption for Dedicated and Private deployments. For our Hosted API, encryption at rest and in transit is provided by the hosting provider by default; customer-managed keys (BYOK) are available for Dedicated and Private deployments via integrations with AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault, or customer HSMs. Access to encryption keys is controlled by customer principals and any Redwood access is restricted, role-based, and audited as part of our SOC2 controls."

jordan (AE): LGTM. Retention phrasing suggestion: "Default retention for embeddings and request logs is 30 days on Hosted. Dedicated and Private retention windows are configurable by contract; we can offer 0-day/ephemeral retention and longer retention on request for compliance needs."

sara (CS): Thanks. Nate — please tack on a SOC2 attestation and legal contact. Also include a link to the SOC2 redacted report.

nate (Legal): Added: "Redwood maintains SOC2 Type II coverage for the control plane and our hosted services. Specific scope and any carve-outs for Dedicated/Private are documented in the SOC2 report appendices. For an executed NDA and report access, contact legal@redwood.com."

sara (CS): I'll paste the combined answers into the vendor form now. They also asked for a short engineer contact for a technical call tomorrow morning — @olivia can you take 30 mins tomorrow 10:00–10:30 PT?

olivia (CSE): I can. Booked on my calendar. :calendar: I'll bring the config examples and a short runbook for key rotation and incident handoff.

dpa-bot: Reminder: please upload completed questionnaire and evidence to /shared/onboarding/ACME/vendor_forms within 24 hours.

sara (CS): Uploaded the filled form and attached the SOC2 link. Thanks everyone — closing the loop. :white_check_mark:
